entities.name: Malynn
entities.description: An elderly, wise crone of Lambholt who teaches the village's children and believes Old Stickfingers is responsible for the killings.

entities.name: Old Stickfingers
entities.description: A mythical boogeyman blamed for the Lambholt murders.

entities.name: Vadrik
entities.description: An archmage called to Lambholt to investigate.

entities.name: Rem Karolus
entities.description: The inquisitor who investigates with Vadrik.

entities.name: Ariosa
entities.description: A village girl who properly finishes the summoning ritual.

events.summary: Malynn, among the council of crones and mothers, calls Vadrik to Lambholt and asserts Old Stickfingers is responsible for the murders.
events.quote: She immediately asserted her belief that Old Stickfingers

events.summary: Malynn gives Vadrik and Rem Karolus lore about Old Stickfingers.
events.quote: Malynn provided valuable insight and historical context about Old Stickfingers

events.summary: Vadrik and the inquisitor confront Old Stickfingers in a grove; Vadrik destroys the twig mobile that summoned it.
events.quote: Vadrik used his magical abilities to analyze and ultimately disrupt the summoning of Old Stickfingers

events.summary: Ariosa finishes the summoning ritual properly, ending the threat to the village.
events.quote: effectively ending the threat against the village
